description: Calm heather landscape with fens surrounded by mixed forest on a winter day in February. Nature reserve 'Kampina Heide' in the Netherlands. A Greylag goose flies over the Kogelvangersven honking. There are more in the water. A little way ahead, out of microphone range, two neighborhood peers with too much time and huge cameras are catching a glimpse of a Great Gray Shrike. They had an overview card with them on which it was written where the Great Gray Shrike should be and asked me for directions. So around here, I said. I'm not a spotter or connoisseur so I don't know if I accidentally spotted the Great Gray Shrike in this hour. Across the fen I hear the "spring carpenter" Woodpecker. Several birds are singing as if it's already May, but it's only mid-February 2023. A freight train races towards the industry. The economy has to go on, or can it be done differently, better? More recordings here during the year's / More here today Date/time: February 14th 2023, start 10:15 am Weather: 2-8c, clear sky, clouds 0%, wind SSE 1-2 bft 5km/h with gusts to 8 kmh, 1034 hPa, humidity 85-85%. Location; Kogelvangersven, Zandbergse vennen, Kampina, Van Gogh Nationaal Park, Boxtel, Noord-Brabant, Netherlands (Holland), Europe geo 51.58019 5.27201 Gear chain: Sennheiser mkh30/50 MS, in Rycote cyclone small, windjammer > Sound Devices 302 >Tascam dr-100 Mk2. Decoded Mid-side to STEREO. Mics pointed South. Noise floor 43 dBA. Post editing; equalizing, mid channel +3 dB.
